note: Predefined test hypotheses (fixtures), NOT measurements. 'mock' is used only by the offline mock LLM.

fixtures.title: Pre-LN trains without warm-up (known)
fixtures.statement: Placing the layer normalization inside the residual branch (Pre-LN) lets a Transformer train stably without a learning-rate warm-up stage and reach results comparable to the Post-LN baseline.

mock.rationale: Claim c01 reports exactly this comparison for Transformers.

fixtures.title: RMSNorm vs LayerNorm, tiny char-level LM, 60 s budget
fixtures.statement: Replacing LayerNorm with RMSNorm lowers the validation loss of a tiny character-level Transformer language model trained for a fixed ~60 second wall-clock budget.

mock.rationale: RMSNorm is reported on other tasks and architectures; no tiny char-level fixed-time setting in the snapshot.

fixtures.title: SwiGLU feed-forward, tiny char-level LM
fixtures.statement: Replacing the GELU feed-forward block with a SwiGLU block lowers the validation loss of a tiny character-level Transformer trained for a fixed ~60 second wall-clock budget.

mock.rationale: GLU variants are reported for seq2seq Transformers, not this regime.

fixtures.title: Squared ReLU, tiny char-level LM
fixtures.statement: Replacing GELU with squared ReLU in the feed-forward block lowers the validation loss of a tiny character-level Transformer trained for a fixed ~60 second wall-clock budget.

mock.rationale: Reported at 500M-1.9B parameters, not this regime.

fixtures.title: RoPE vs learned positions, tiny char-level LM
fixtures.statement: Replacing learned absolute position embeddings with rotary position embeddings (RoPE) lowers the validation loss of a tiny character-level Transformer trained for a fixed ~60 second wall-clock budget.

mock.rationale: Reported on long text classification, not this regime.
